author: Zintenka
body:
We need to become more used to Trinitrotoluene warfare. Will attract a lot of people and add some diversity to the game.

As it is, we only have a few maps that are actually Trinitrotoluene based. Like CherrylandMC or Crescent: Subtle. Even at that, the amount in each is very small.

I'd suggest to add checks which prevent certain blocks from being destroyed by Trinitrotoluene. 

Half-joke/Half-Serious post.
